text:
alex: heads up — attempted `terraform apply` to scale eu-gpu-pool +4 nodes, got: "Error acquiring the state lock: resource locked by terraform-runner-21" and apply aborted.

sam: seeing same in CI. Argo re-tried 2x, then gitlab runner retried, now 3 concurrent attempts. :grimacing:

maria: logs show DynamoDB lock entry present but lease renewal stopped after a 502 to S3 from the runner ~1725034500. owner = terraform-runner-21.

ira: sounds like a retry storm + no splay on backoff. GitOps job concurrency is 3 and retry interval is tiny (5s). we should add jitter/splay.

alex: manual workaround — can force-unlock but want to avoid data loss. current lock ID = terraform/infra/eu-gpu (owner terraform-runner-21). wondering if runner PID still alive.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-3456 — Terraform lock contention during GPU pool scale. Paging @oncall.

sam: confirmed runner pod crashed (OOM) on node. safe to force-unlock after verifying pod dead. I'll run `terraform force-unlock -force d8f3a2c5` from ops workstation.

alex: please annotate who did it and paste the owner metadata before deleting. also adding step to pause auto-retries in Argo.

sam: did the force-unlock, pasted lock metadata to incident. re-running apply now.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline #1289 retriggered by sam — job: infra/tf-apply/eu-gpu (runner=terraform-runner-22).

maria: apply progressed but we saw a partial state move attempt earlier — looks like a workspace split import started concurrently which changed the key prefix. that may be why the lock owner persisted after the pod died (import bumped TTL semantics).

ira: immediate actions: 1) add exponential backoff + jitter to gitops apply job, 2) reduce concurrency to 1 for tf apply to this workspace, 3) add pre-check probe that verifies current lock owner is alive before enqueue.

alex: agreed. for quick config: propose `TF_LOCK_RETRY_COUNT=6`, `TF_LOCK_RETRY_SPLAY=15-90`, and set Argo concurrency 1 for `infra/tf-apply/*`.

maria: I'll open a PR with the CI change and the pre-check script (small bash probe to call `aws dynamodb get-item` and owner PID check). linking: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/987 (draft).

sam: after unlock finished scaling, new GPU nodes registered, k8s node-approval automated hook accepted them, smoke tests green :tada:.

ira: follow-up RFC: bump Dynamo lock TTL to 60s and implement a small renew loop in our terraform-runner container to reduce orphaned locks on transient network blips. also add a reconcile job that finds stale owners older than 5m and opens a blocked change review instead of immediate force-delete.

alex: makes sense. filing task in infra backlog and tagging @platform for review. thanks everyone for quick response. :thumbsup:
